name: com.catsplatstudios.sfxforge
description: Plays the sounds and songs of SFX FORGE, a game-audio synthesizer for VIBE FM, in a Unity game with the device's own engine: patches written in code or exported from the device become assets, sound effects are synthesized live or baked to clips, and a song's layers follow the game. Includes a MIDI link to the device for tuning while the game runs, the manuals, and a showcase game as a sample. Windows x64 only.

samples.description: Brio: First Harmonic, a one-level 2D platformer in which every sound is SFX FORGE at runtime: 19 sound effects written as patches in code and a song whose layers follow the player's speed. Needs the built-in render pipeline and the legacy Input Manager (or Both); its tests need the Test Framework package.
